description.value: Daylu Dena Fuels is a year-round convenience store and fuel station located just off the Alaska Highway in the remote community of Lower Post, BC, near the BC-Yukon border. Owned and operated by the Daylu Dena Council, it sells gasoline, diesel, and food — making it a critical resupply point in one of the most isolated stretches of the Alaska Highway corridor. For cycle tourists travelling the Alaska Highway, it is among the very few services available in this region.

address.value: 5 Old Alaska Highway, Lower Post, V0C 1W0
